svg.data-weight-note: 21.12 lb (9.58 kg) with two power supplies and six fan modules installed (Table 9)
svg.data-depth-note: 20.27 in (51.5 cm) excluding the fan and power supply handles (Table 9)
svg.data-qsfp28-speeds: 100 or 40 GbE; ports 0 to 30 channelize to 4 x 25, 4 x 10 or 2 x 50 GbE
svg.data-qsfp28-port-31: 100, 40 or 2 x 50 GbE only, because its lanes are shared with the 10 GbE SFP+ port (Table 5)
svg.data-power-input-ac: 100 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz, 6 A at 100 VAC and 3.8 A at 240 VAC
svg.data-power-input-dc: rated -48 to -60 VDC, operating range -40.8 to -72 VDC, 16 A maximum
svg.data-redundancy-note: two supplies, load-sharing and fully redundant; both should be installed
svg.data-fans: six fan modules, 5+1; the switch runs 30 seconds without thermal shutdown while one is replaced
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F) normal operation
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 to 70 C (-40 to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation to 5000 m (16,404 ft)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 2 switches of the same model; any non-channelized QSFP28 port (0 to 31) can be a virtual chassis port, from 20.3R1
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100 GbE or 40 GbE; channelizes to 4 x 25 GbE, 4 x 10 GbE or 2 x 50 GbE (guide Table 5)
svg.data-oob: one RJ-45 management port (MGMT) on the port side, with a link activity lamp
